surface_mechanism_description: The surface reactions involve the adsorption of W2(NMe2)6 and H2S, leading to the formation of WS2 through a self-limiting surface reaction mechanism. The process includes a postdeposition annealing step in H2S/N2 atmosphere at 400 °C to crystallize the films.
